outcome: Session tokens expire, and the signing key can rotate without logging everyone out.

acceptance_criteria.text: A token past its expiry is rejected however valid its signature.

expected_verification.assertion: a token signed with the current key but expired one second ago verifies false

acceptance_criteria.text: During rotation, tokens signed by the previous key verify until the window closes: one ttl after rotate(), or the next rotation, whichever is first.

expected_verification.assertion: after rotate(), a token from the old key verifies true, one signed with a never-known key verifies false, and an old-key token presented one ttl after rotation verifies false

acceptance_criteria.text: A service misconfigured with no signing secret refuses to construct rather than falling back.

expected_verification.assertion: constructing with an empty secret throws

data_impact: None. Tokens are stateless; nothing is stored or migrated.
security_impact: Session verification: expiry enforced, key rotation with a time-bounded one-key window, refusal on a missing secret, platform constant-time comparison, one canonical token string per token.
rollout: Deploy the verifier first; issue with the new claims once every verifier accepts them. Rotation is a runtime call.
rollback: Revert the package; previously issued tokens keep verifying under the current key.
